action.code:
import json
for p in ['packet_a','packet_b']:
    print("="*60); print(p)
    rules = {}
    for line in open(f'{p}/rules.txt'):
        line=line.strip()
        if '=' in line:
            k,v=line.split('=',1)
            rules[k]=v
    print("rules:", rules)
    cand = [json.loads(l) for l in open(f'{p}/candidates.jsonl')]
    asm = [json.loads(l) for l in open(f'{p}/assessments.jsonl')]
    print("candidates count:", len(cand), "assessments count:", len(asm))
    print("sample candidate:", cand[0])
    print("sample assessment:", asm[0])
